title: BUGFIX — Achiri: Ollama timeout falls back to Anthropic haiku instead of error message
rationale: logs/achiri-api-error.log shows repeated timeout errors from Ollama (qwen3:4b) every 30-60s today: 'DOMException [AbortError]: This operation was aborted'. Free tier users are getting 'Serveur chwaya b6i2 tawa' error messages instead of responses. The 130s Ollama timeout fires because qwen3:4b is slow under load. Fix: when local/Ollama call throws AbortError/timeout, attempt a 45s Anthropic haiku fallback before returning the error message. This ensures the user always gets a reply even when the local model is too slow.
outputs: agents/achiri/index.ts (add Anthropic fallback in catch block for local timeout)
success_criteria: When Ollama times out, an Anthropic claude-haiku-4-5 fallback is attempted
If fallback succeeds, user gets a real reply (not the error message)
If both fail, original error message is returned

tasks.description: agents/achiri/index.ts: in the catch block for local provider timeout, attempt Anthropic haiku fallback with 45s timeout before returning the 'server slow' message. Log '[Achiri] ollama-timeout → anthropic-fallback' when fallback fires.
